records.jp: どうだった？
records.en_original: How was it?
records.en: How was it?

records.jp: まだ雨漏りは続いてるみたい
records.en_original: It still seems to be leaking.
records.en: It still seems to be leaking.

records.jp: 雨は止んだけど……。<CR>どこかに水が溜まってるってこと？
records.en_original: Even though the rain stopped? Did some water pool up somewhere?
records.en: Even though the rain stopped? Did some water pool up somewhere?

records.jp: やっぱりちゃんと直さないと危なそうだねー
records.en_original: I guess we'll have to fix it properly after all.
records.en: I guess we'll have to fix it properly after all.

records.jp: 昨日話した通り“向こうの世界”に行ってみようか
records.en_original: Should we go to the Faraway like we planned, then?
records.en: Should we go to the Faraway like we planned, then?

records.jp: うん。直せるものをさがさないとね
records.en_original: Yes. We need to find something we can use to fix it.
records.en: Yes. We need to find something we can use to fix it.

records.jp: それじゃ、金城さんはいつも通りお留守番お願い
records.en_original: Watch the place while we're gone, Kinjou.
records.en: Watch the place while we're gone, Kinjou.

records.jp: えー！　あたしもついてく！
records.en_original: Whaaaat! I wanna go too!
records.en: Whaaaat! I wanna go too!

records.jp: 危険だよ。金城さん、戦う力が無いんだから
records.en_original: It's too dangerous. You know you can't fight.
records.en: It's too dangerous. You know you can't fight.

records.jp: もー、なんであたしは戦えないんだろ……
records.en_original: Ugh, why am I the only one who can't fight?
records.en: Ugh, why am I the only one who can't fight?

records.jp: （そう……勇希は私たちと違って<CR>指輪の力が使えない）
records.en_original: (That's right... Yuki can't use her ring's powers, unlike the rest of us.)
records.en: (That's right... Yuki can't use her ring's powers, unlike the rest of us.)

records.jp: （そもそも指輪の力について知ったのは、私たちが<CR>初めて“向こうの世界”に行った時だった）
records.en_original: (It was our first time in the Faraway that we learned our rings had special powers.)
records.en: (It was our first time in the Faraway that we learned our rings had special powers.)

records.jp: はぁ、はぁ…………。<CR>ちょ、あれ、何！！　あいつ！！
records.en_original: *Pant* *pant* What. Was that.
records.en: *Pant* *pant* What. Was that.

records.jp: …………リフナビ！　あいつに聞こう！
records.en_original: ...ReSource! Let's ask it!
records.en: ...ReSource! Let's ask it!

records.jp: それだ！　こころっ！
records.en_original: Good idea! Kokoro!
records.en: Good idea! Kokoro!

records.jp: うん、分かったよ
records.en_original: On it!
records.en: On it!

records.jp: あの、リフナビさん
records.en_original: Um, ReSource?
records.en: Um, ReSource?

records.jp: はよ～ん！　なになに？
records.en_original: Hello hello hello! What's up?
records.en: Hello hello hello! What's up?

records.jp: なんか、この前言ってた世界の中で、<CR>やばいのが出てきて
records.en_original: So, you know that world we talked about before? Something crazy appeared...
records.en: So, you know that world we talked about before? Something crazy appeared...

records.jp: もー、だから絶対近づかないでって言ったのに。<CR>自業自得だよ☆
records.en_original: Didn't I tell you to stay away? That's what you get!
records.en: Didn't I tell you to stay away? That's what you get!

records.jp: 悪かったから！<CR>お願い、どうすればいいの！？
records.en_original: Okay, we're sorry! Please, just help us!
records.en: Okay, we're sorry! Please, just help us!

records.jp: まあ、入っちゃったものは仕方ないしね。<CR>それじゃあ、説明するよ！
records.en_original: Well, you've already gone in, so no point in warning you anymore. Let me explain!
records.en: Well, you've already gone in, so no point in warning you anymore. Let me explain!

records.jp: ここにはモンスターと呼ばれる敵性生物が<CR>出現するよ♪
records.en_original: Here in this world, hostile creatures known as demons will appear!
records.en: Here in this world, hostile creatures known as demons will appear!

records.jp: とても恐ろしく見えるけど大丈夫☆　<CR>モンスターに対処する方法もちゃんとあるよん！
records.en_original: They may look majorly scary, but don't worry! There's a way to deal with these pesky things!
records.en: They may look majorly scary, but don't worry! There's a way to deal with these pesky things!

records.jp: え？　そうなの？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: みんな、つけてる指輪に想いを込めよう！<CR>“リフレクター”の武器を生み出すんだッ！
records.en_original: Call forth your Reflector weapon by infusing the rings you're wearing with your feelings!
records.en: Call forth your Reflector weapon by infusing the rings you're wearing with your feelings!

records.jp: リフレクター……？
records.en_original: Reflector...?
records.en: Reflector...?

records.jp: あ、武器を生み出せるのは『リフレクター反応』の<CR>出ている愛央さん、こころさん、伶那さんだけです☆
records.en_original: Oh, right. Ao, Kokoro, and Rena have the Reflector reaction, so they're the only ones who can use these weapons.
records.en: Oh, right. Ao, Kokoro, and Rena have the Reflector reaction, so they're the only ones who can use these weapons.

records.jp: なんであたしだけ仲間外れ！？
records.en_original: Why am I the only one left out?!
records.en: Why am I the only one left out?!

records.jp: なっ！？　みんな！　言ってる場合じゃなかった！<CR>あいつら！　モンスター来てる！
records.en_original: Wha—?! Hey, guys! I don't think this is a good time to talk! Demons!
records.en: Wha—?! Hey, guys! I don't think this is a good time to talk! Demons!

records.jp: ちょ、早くない！？
records.en_original: So soon?!
records.en: So soon?!

records.jp: ……しょうがない、一か八かだ！<CR>みんな、指輪を！　……えー、あたし以外！
records.en_original: I think it's do or die time... Everyone use your rings! Well, everyone except me!
records.en: I think it's do or die time... Everyone use your rings! Well, everyone except me!

records.jp: 指輪……
records.en_original: Our rings...
records.en: Our rings...

records.jp: 想いを込めるって、何を！？
records.en_original: What did they mean infuse our feelings?!
records.en: What did they mean infuse our feelings?!

records.jp: 分かんない！　ラーメン食べたいとか、<CR>ケーキ食べたいとか……とにかく思いついたもので！
records.en_original: I dunno! Just...feelings ya know? Like, a craving for ramen. Or cake! Whatever you can come up with!
records.en: I dunno! Just...feelings ya know? Like, a craving for ramen. Or cake! Whatever you can come up with!

records.jp: 食べるのばっかじゃん！
records.en_original: All you think about is food!
records.en: All you think about is food!

records.jp: 想い……想い……
records.en_original: Feelings... Feelings...
records.en: Feelings... Feelings...

records.jp: 想い……
records.en_original: Feelings...
records.en: Feelings...

records.jp: 『何者かになりたい』
records.en_original: I want to be somebody...
records.en: I want to be somebody...

records.jp: ……わっ！　何これ……？
records.en_original: ...Ah! What's happening?
records.en: ...Ah! What's happening?

records.jp: （……そうして、私たちは指輪の力を知ったんだ）
records.en_original: (...And that's how we discovered the powers the rings had.)
records.en: (...And that's how we discovered the powers the rings had.)

records.jp: やっぱりヤダ！　あたしも行く！　寂しいもん！
records.en_original: No, I'm going too! It's so lonely here all by myself.
records.en: No, I'm going too! It's so lonely here all by myself.

records.jp: そんなこと言ったって……
records.en_original: That's not the point...
records.en: That's not the point...

records.jp: まあ、私たちがちゃんと守れば大丈夫……かな？
records.en_original: Well, there shouldn't be a problem if we just protect her. ...Right?
records.en: Well, there shouldn't be a problem if we just protect her. ...Right?

records.jp: やったー！　愛央優しい！
records.en_original: Yaaaay! I love you, Ao!
records.en: Yaaaay! I love you, Ao!

records.jp: でも、危なくなったら逃げるんだよ？
records.en_original: But if things get nasty, you have to run away. Got it?
records.en: But if things get nasty, you have to run away. Got it?

records.jp: りょうかいりょうかい！
records.en_original: Yes, ma'am!
records.en: Yes, ma'am!
